prompt:
Create ONE polished native editable static SVG with TWO proposed future Last Hearth Glasspool Newt creature portraits: NORMAL LEFT and ASCENDED RIGHT. These are visual-development candidates, not accepted canon or gameplay rules. Exact canvas/viewBox 1440x512, two 720x512 cells. Top-level groups newt-normal transform="translate(0 0)" and newt-ascended transform="translate(720 0)". All painted shapes belong to their cell group, which begins with a full local 720x512 #172928 background rectangle. Complete subject/support stays inside local x=40..680,y=36..476. No labels, writing, stats, borders, logos, watermark or UI.
FAMILY IDENTITY: small smooth-skinned teal newt, short broad blunt head, small fitted dark eyes, low elongated continuous torso, FOUR short splayed legs with rounded toe tips, and one long laterally flattened tail growing continuously from the pelvis. Tail is the strongest identifying contour; keep it separate from all four feet. No external gills, crocodile teeth/scales, dragon horns, oversized frog haunches, mammal paws or a shell. Shoulder/hip roots merge into living skin, elbows/ankles bend naturally, head and short neck continuously join the torso. No floating head, limbs or detached joint caps. Forefeet have four short rounded digits and hindfeet five, simplified at tiny scale without a spray of needles.
NORMAL: three-quarter low resting watch on one broad wet stone, head turned gently toward viewer. One forefoot reaches slightly ahead of the other. The body curves through an open C-shaped tail loop behind and beside it; all four feet have clear staggered supporting contacts. Tail remains one continuous taper, never a second head.
ASCENDED: same species/proportions/palette now leans forward and upward across a sloping forked root at the edge of shallow water. One forefoot plants higher on the root, the other braces lower; hindfeet visibly carry the body. The connected tail sweeps back in a higher open S arc and reveals its modest low soft dorsal crest. Change body angle, supporting levels, tail gesture and silhouette together, not just colors, gold ornaments or mirroring. Keep the full tail/head/feet inside the cell and leave large readable negative spaces.
STYLE: Hearth expressive engraved fantasy illustration, connected organic curves, broad three-value modeled planes before sparse contour-following engraving. Teal skin #4b7d75, sage upper planes #87aa96, pale ivory underside/light #d9dfbd, tiny restrained ochre #b9a06a dorsal marks, quiet dark forest field. Upper-left light. Soft living skin with restrained wet highlights, not glossy plastic or metal. Avoid repeated scales, dense reeds/scenery, floating ornaments and decorative noise. Material and gesture must read at 160x112, 80x56 and 64x45. Spend geometry on continuous anatomy, visible load-bearing contacts and distinct tail silhouette. Economical roughly 40-65 filled paths per cell is a soft target, not a reason to break organic curves.
OUTPUT: native static vector paths and simple shapes with explicit flat paints only. No raster/image elements, external resources, scripts, animation, use references, defs, gradients or filters. Both named groups must extract independently in local coordinates without cross-cell debris.
